The Samsung Galaxy Watch Active is a smartwatch manufactured, developed and developed by Samsung Electronics. It was announced on February 20, 2019 at the Samsung's Galaxy Unpacked event, alongside the Galaxy S10 series, the Galaxy Fold, the Galaxy Fit/Fit e and the Galaxy Buds.[1] The Galaxy Watch Active was scheduled for availability in the United States starting on March 8, 2019.
